summary: Discover bounded Kotlin declarations through the generic language profile for agent source navigation.

scope.boundary: Extract declarations and source locations; do not type-check, compile, or model the standard library.

hermeticEvidence.fixture: synthetic Kotlin sources with nested declarations, extension functions, annotations, and excluded trees

releaseBoundary: Missing grammar forms remain ordinary source text; no complete-language or held-out-project claim.

discovery.dominanceRule: A language with at least 10 files and at least four times all other recognized source files is recommended before generic-source; genuinely mixed corpora retain generic-source first.
discovery.caseInsensitiveRootAliasPolicy: Optional root aliases that resolve to the same filesystem entry are indexed once.
